svg.title: PostgreSQL document lifecycle
svg.desc: PostgreSQL document lifecycle data model. The documents table holds an incarnation UUID. The chunks, document_fingerprints, ingest_jobs and document_pdf_extractions tables reference documents.id with cascading deletion. The source_uploads table journals original-file uploads and references documents.id with cascading deletion once acceptance links an upload. The evaluation_fixtures table keeps receipt-qualified UUID reservations, and its active_document_id reference to documents.id restricts deletion until cleanup completes. PK denotes primary key and FK denotes foreign key. SQL types appear beside every column.
